title: "Day 3 Revision: SACRD Model (Asymptomatic vs. Clinical Infections)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk[["set"]](echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(deSolve)
```

## 1. Baseline SACRD Model vs. Standard SIR
Here, `gamma = 0.2` is the **clinical fraction** (20% become clinical `C`, 80% remain asymptomatic `A`). Notice `taua = 1/20` (asymptomatic infections last 20 days) vs. `tauc = 1/10` (clinical infections last 10 days).

```{r sacrd-vs-sir}
SACRD <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    P <- (S + A + C + R)
    # Both A and C transmit equally in baseline model
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * (A + C) / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S   
    dA <- (1 - gamma) * lam * S - taua * A - mu * A
    dC <- gamma * lam * S - tauc * C - mu * C 
    dR <- (1 - phi) * tauc * C + taua * A - mu * R
    dD <- phi * tauc * C   # Only clinical cases (C) suffer disease-induced mortality
    
    list(c(dS, dA, dC, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

initP <- 999 
initA <- 0
initC <- 1
initR <- 0 
initD <- 0
initS <- initP - initA - initC - initR
istate <- c(S = initS, A = initA, C = initC, R = initR, D = initD)

parameters <- c(
  mu = (1 / (50 * 52 * 7)),    
  beta = 0.25, 
  gamma = 0.2,    # 20% probability of developing clinical symptoms
  taua = 1 / 20,  # 20-day duration for asymptomatic cases
  tauc = 1 / 10,  # 10-day duration for clinical cases
  phi = 0.05      # 5% Case Fatality Ratio among clinical cases
)

time_start <- 0
time_stop <- 600
deltat <- 0.1
tps <- seq(time_start, time_stop, by = deltat)

out <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SACRD, parms = parameters) 
Result <- as.data.frame(out)

# Phase plane: Susceptibles (S) vs Total Active Infections (A + C)
plot(Result[["S"]], Result[["C"]] + Result[["A"]], type = "l", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 500), xlim = c(0, 1000),
     xlab = "Susceptible (S)", ylab = "Total Infected (A + C)",
     main = "SACRD vs. Standard SIR Phase Plane")

# Compare with SIR_model2 (where everyone has a 10-day infectious period)
SIR_model2 <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    P <- (S + I + R)
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * I / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S         
    dI <- lam * S - (1 - phi) * tau * I - delta * phi * I - mu * I 
    dR <- (1 - phi) * tau * I - mu * R
    dD <- delta * phi * I
    list(c(dS, dI, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

istate2 <- c(S = 998, I = 1, R = 0, D = 0)
parameters2 <- c(mu = (1/(50*52*7)), beta = 0.25, tau = 1/10, delta = 1/10, phi = 0.05)

out2 <- deSolve::ode(y = istate2, times = tps, func = SIR_model2, parms = parameters2) 
Result2 <- as.data.frame(out2)

# Overlay SIR trajectory in blue (much smaller peak because average infectious period is 10d vs 18d)
lines(Result2[["S"]], Result2[["I"]], col = "dodgerblue3", lwd = 3)
legend("topright", legend = c("SACRD (taua=1/20, tauc=1/10)", "SIR2 (tau=1/10)"),
       col = c("black", "dodgerblue3"), lwd = c(2, 3))
```

## 2. Effect of Longer Asymptomatic Duration (`taua`) & Lower Transmission (`rho`)
When `beta = 0.09`, a 10-day duration (`taua = 1/10`) yields $R_0 < 1$, whereas a 20-day asymptomatic duration (`taua = 1/20`) pushes $R_0 > 1$. Adding `rho = 0.75` reduces asymptomatic infectiousness by 25%.

```{r sacrd-rho}
# Test low beta (0.09) with short (10d) vs long (20d) asymptomatic duration
parameters['beta'] <- 0.09
parameters['taua'] <- 1 / 10
out_lowbeta <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SACRD, parms = parameters) 

parameters['taua'] <- 1 / 20
out3_lowbeta <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SACRD, parms = parameters) 

plot(out_lowbeta[, 2], out_lowbeta[, 3] + out_lowbeta[, 4], type = "l", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 150), xlim = c(0, 1000),
     xlab = "Susceptible (S)", ylab = "Total Infected (A + C)",
     main = "Low Beta (0.09): Impact of Asymptomatic Duration & Rho")
lines(out3_lowbeta[, 2], out3_lowbeta[, 3] + out3_lowbeta[, 4], col = "seagreen2", lwd = 3)

# SACRD with reduced asymptomatic infectiousness (rho = 0.75)
SACRD_rho <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    P <- (S + A + C + R)
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * (A * rho + C) / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S   
    dA <- (1 - gamma) * lam * S - taua * A - mu * A
    dC <- gamma * lam * S - tauc * C - mu * C 
    dR <- (1 - phi) * tauc * C + taua * A - mu * R
    dD <- phi * tauc * C
    list(c(dS, dA, dC, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

parameters['rho'] <- 0.75
# Fixed typo: using 'istate' instead of undefined 'istate_a'
out3r_lowbeta <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SACRD_rho, parms = parameters) 

lines(out3r_lowbeta[, 2], out3r_lowbeta[, 3] + out3r_lowbeta[, 4], col = "violetred", lwd = 3)
legend("topright", legend = c("taua=1/10 (R0 < 1)", "taua=1/20, rho=1", "taua=1/20, rho=0.75"),
       col = c("black", "seagreen2", "violetred"), lwd = c(2, 3, 3))
```
